text:
sylvia: pushed asymmetric-batching + on-demand chunked-KV fetch to prod at 07:12 PT. Canary ramp 5% -> 20% -> 100%. logging initial numbers here.

ci-bot: deploy started: commit f1b2c33 -> prod | canary=5% -> 20% -> 100% | sha f1b2c33 | est 00:17:00

joel: grabbed 40m of stable traffic after 100% ramp. Headline: p50 -8%, p95 -36%, p99 -23%, unit cost per 1k tokens -21%.

faizal: concrete: before {p50: 92ms, p95: 255ms, p99: 510ms, cost_1k: $0.046} after {p50: 85ms, p95: 163ms, p99: 392ms, cost_1k: $0.036}

sylvia: quick notes on changes: asymmetric-batching groups small requests aggressively but lets heavy requests bypass batching lanes; on-demand chunked-KV fetch streams KV pages during decoding to avoid monolithic fetches for long-context. also added short-term per-session TTL for KV to improve cache reuse.

observability: breakdown: short requests (<=64) saw ~30% cost win and biggest p95 improvement. mixed/medium saw ~18% cost win. long-context (>1500) p99 improved ~12% primarily due to chunked fetch reducing blocking stalls.

runtime-oncall: infra: small spike in request queues during 20% step (~70s) but autoscaler caught up. no OOMs. saw a flurry of 429s from a legacy SDK variant during canary — fallback to older route worked. filed OBS-10212 for client-compat.

joel: one oddity: a tiny subset of sessions showed slightly higher p50 (~+3ms) — looks related to the new per-session TTL warming logic; tuning in progress.

sylvia: created follow-up ticket RUNTIME-1218 to tune TTL heuristics. will default back if p50 regresses more than 5% for 30m.

docs: product/CS want a one-paragraph blurb + an FAQ line. Draft: "Short-context apps should expect ~20-30% lower inference cost and noticeably faster p95 latency. Long-context workloads benefit at p99 due to streaming KV fetches, but unit-cost wins are smaller. See linked perf graphs."

observability: perf graph: https://internal.redwood/perf/graphs/1796104567 (internal only).

ci-bot: deploy finished: commit f1b2c33 -> prod | status=success | duration=00:26:44 :rocket:

runtime-oncall: monitoring 48h. Will post if any p99 regression > baseline for 15m. great work team :tada:
